lyrics.text: Kingdom come kingdom come
Hear the pulse of my drum
Righteous fire in my soul
Gonna make the broken whole
Kingdom come kingdom come
Hear the pulse of my drum
Righteous fire in my soul
Yo, from the shadowed peaks where dragons sleep, I roam
Through ancient forests, making evil flee my home.
With enchanted blade and courage bright, I stand,
A shield for the weak, across this mystic land.
Kingdom come kingdom come
Righteous fire in my soul
Gonna help the broken whole
Beasts of nightmare, magic dark, they fall before my might,
Every step a legend, blazing through the night.
For the innocent, I fight, with a warrior's grace,
Bringing dawn to darkness, leaving no trace.
Kingdom come kingdom come
Hear the beat of my drum
Holy fire in my bones
Across the plains of peril, where the wicked plots reside,
My spirit's an arrow, piercing through their pride.
With spells unbound, and ancient oaths I keep,
Kingdom come kingdom come
Hear the beat of my drum
Righteous fire in my soul
Gonna make the shattered whole
From forgotten ruins to the wizard's cursed lair,
A beacon of justice, against the creeping dread,
Restoring balance, until all evil's bled.
Kingdom come kingdom come
Hear the beat of my drum
Righteous fire in my soul
